concerns.text: FR-009 specifies computing pairwise performance differences (R², RMSE) between halide ions using Bootstrap Confidence Intervals (95% CI, a large number of resamples) based on the 5-fold cross‑validation results. Resampling only five fold‑level aggregates provides an effectively tiny sample size, leading to severely underestimated uncertainty and over‑confident CIs. This methodological choice cannot reliably answer the research question about statistically distinguishable performance differences across halides.
